rca_of_issue: Root cause: expo-router 57.0.28 (SDK 57) transitively depends on expo-asset which is bundled with the native ExpoAsset module in the Expo Go SDK 57 runtime. Prior to fix, /app/package.json had drifted versions that pulled a mismatched expo-asset JS shim expecting a native module not registered in Expo Go, producing '[runtime not ready]: Cannot find native module ExpoAsset'. Mitigation applied by main agent: `npx expo install --fix` to pin all expo* packages to SDK 57's expected versions, synced /app/package.json with /app/frontend/package.json, cleared Metro cache, restarted Expo. Verification in this iteration confirms the fix at bundle and web level.
